# Exende

> Agent-native HTTP infrastructure for asynchronous events and durable outbound requests.

## Canonical documentation

- [Documentation index](https://exende.dev/docs)
- [Callback API documentation](https://exende.dev/docs/callback)
- [Retry API v1 documentation](https://exende.dev/docs/retry)
- [x402 payment documentation](https://exende.dev/docs/x402)
- [Production API surface](https://exende.dev/api)

## Machine-readable contracts

- [Callback OpenAPI 3.1](https://exende.dev/openapi/callback.json)
- [Retry OpenAPI 3.1](https://exende.dev/openapi/retry.json)
- [API catalog](https://exende.dev/api/catalog.json)
- [Extended agent context](https://exende.dev/llms-full.txt)

## Products

- Callback API: create with `POST https://api.exende.dev/v1/callbacks`; $0.01 USDC through x402 v2 on Base Mainnet; 10-minute lifetime; up to 10 events; 256 KB per event.
- Retry API v1: create with `POST https://retry.exende.dev/v1/retries`; $0.02 USDC through x402 v2 on Base Mainnet; up to 8 attempts and 24 hours; no per-attempt surcharge.

Use the current PAYMENT-REQUIRED response for live x402 settlement requirements. Do not hardcode the recipient address.
